propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryDuct
propertySets.definition: Fluid flow performance history attached to an instance of IfcPerformanceHistory assigned to IfcDistributionPort.  This replaces the deprecated IfcFluidFlowProperties for performance values.

properties.name: TemperatureHistory
properties.definition: Temperature of the fluid. For air this value represents the dry bulb temperature.

properties.name: WetBulbTemperatureHistory
properties.definition: Wet bulb temperature of the fluid; only applicable if the fluid is air.

properties.name: VolumetricFlowRateHistory
properties.definition: The volumetric flow rate of the fluid.

properties.name: MassFlowRateHistory
properties.definition: The mass flow rate of the fluid.

properties.name: FlowConditionHistory
properties.definition: Defines the flow condition as a percentage of the cross-sectional area.

propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionPortTypeDuct
propertySets.definition: Duct port occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcDistributionPort.

properties.name: ConnectionType
properties.definition:
The end-style treatment of the duct port:BEADEDSLEEVE: Beaded Sleeve.
COMPRESSION: Compression.
CRIMP: Crimp.
DRAWBAND: Drawband.
DRIVESLIP: Drive slip.
FLANGED: Flanged.
OUTSIDESLEEVE: Outside Sleeve.
SLIPON: Slipon.
SOLDERED: Soldered.
SSLIP: S-Slip.
STANDINGSEAM: Standing seam.
SWEDGE: Swedge.
WELDED: Welded.
OTHER: Another type of end-style has been applied.
NONE: No end-style has been applied.

properties.name: ConnectionSubtype
properties.definition:
The physical port connection subtype that further qualifies the ConnectionType. The following values are recommended:ACPLUG: A, B, C, D, E, F, EF, G, H, I, J, K, L, M
DIN: Mini3P, Mini4P, Mini5P, Mini6P, Mini7P, Mini8P, Mini9P
DSub: DA15, DB25, DC37, DD50, DE9, DE15
EIAJ: RC5720
HDMI: A, B, C
RADIO: IEEE802.11g, IEEE802.11n
RJ: 4P4C, 6P2C, 8P8C
SOCKET: E-11, E-12, E-14, E-17, E-26, E-27, E-39, E-40
TRS: TS_Mini, TS_SubMini, TRS_Mini, TRS_SubMini

properties.name: NominalWidth
properties.definition: The nominal overall width of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: NominalHeight
properties.definition:
The nominal height of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

The nominal height of the duct connection. Only provided for rectangular shaped ducts.

properties.name: NominalThickness
properties.definition: The nominal thickness of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: DryBulbTemperature
properties.definition:
Dry bulb temperature of the object.

Indicates dry bulb temperature of the air.

properties.name: WetBulbTemperature
properties.definition: Wet bulb temperature of the air.

properties.name: VolumetricFlowRate
properties.definition: The volumetric flow rate of the fluid.
